title: Random equations on a cycle: the printed formula is wrong, the corrected one is proved
outcome: Disproved as printed; corrected formula proved
summary: The printed formula for the consistency probability of a cycle is false; the corrected formula is proved.
source: P. Horak, I. Semaev, "Inconsistency Probability of Sparse Equations over F2", arXiv:2603.24890v1 (26 March 2026), the conjecture of the last subsection.
label: lean
